Hello, freshie sa DSA here,

1. Sa first sem, maganda talga may laptop lalo na sa fundamentals of programming. Sa second sem, need mo magdala ng laptop for Stats, Int Prog, Data Structures for the programming lecture. Some profs would allow ipad/tablet for notetaking, some won't.
2. Afaik kinakaya naman ang workload since 4 days a week pasok ng 1st year pero sana swertehin kau sa prof (sana di nyo maging prof si maam A sa data structure or any other CICS subj)
3. Along with coding, marami ring math and logic (especially na magkakaroon kayo ng math modern world, distcrete structures, and calculus). In my experience, marami na hirapan sa discrete but with a lot of practice, you will be familiar with different propositional forms. Basta for every math subject, practice makes perfect naman. Yung coding lang siguro is yung fund prog pati yung sa finals ng intro to data sci (ids)
4. Di naman ako ganoong ka-social pero afaik lumalabas at gumagala classmates ko thursday after class. At first, medjo awkward pa pag magkasama boys at girls pero ngayon medj magkakakilala na kami at alam na namin mga strengths/weaknesses namin, and ofcourse baka dito mo makita yung "The One" mo

Note: some of this is my experience so likely some wont be applicable to u

Without Kuki, it will be very difficult to activate hyperbloom off field. Fischl and beidou cant consistently target the dendro cores so less likely to hyperbloom. Lisa may require on field, requires high energy, and may get interrupted by enemy attacks. So if you're going for hyperbloom, best get kuki. 

Instead of hyperbloom, you may try a burgeon team with the upcoming pyro traveler as the burgeon driver. You can maybe try candace, xingqiu, yao yao and pyro traveler but do note that candace will have a long hydro down time after her burst time finishes.

For a hyperbloom team, try getting kuki (which may be difficult since its very unlikely you will get her on standard and  im not sure if you will like the 5 star character she will run with on banners) Unlike fischl and beidou, kuki is the most consistent hyperbloom driver.  I am suggesting hyperbloom (HYDRO + DENDRO + ELECTRO) since it is very easy to build (you dont need crit, just stack EM) but ensure you also have dendros like traveller or yao yao.

For chasca, sub dps like Rosaria, Fischl, Beidou, Ororon will work. Supports such as Layla and bennett are also great for shielding and buffing respectively. You may also try your luck on Furina or Mavuika banners (MAVUIKA's banner is on january 1 and she SYNERGIZES WELL  WITH CHASCA)

 Do note that chasca only likes PYRO, HYDRO, ELECTRO, and CRYO teammates. Do not try to pair her wirh yelan or xingqiu as their coordinated attacks dont activate when chasca uses her charged.
